official.source_snapshot: 数据/external/LaBraM; pinned files downloaded through the GitHub Contents API
official.checkpoint_torch_weights_only_reason: The verified official checkpoint container includes numpy.core.multiarray.scalar metadata; weights_only=False follows the official loader after SHA256 verification
official.vqnsp_reason: vqnsp.pth is the neural tokenizer used for pretraining; the official downstream classification path only loads labram-base.pth

channels.legacy_mapping_reason: The pinned official standard_1020 list directly contains T3, T4, T5 and T6; their official learned positions are used without substitution or reordering

operations_in_order: MNE zero-phase 4th-order Butterworth SOS bandpass 0.1-75 Hz
preprocessing.short_trial_filter_adaptation: The official automatic 0.1 Hz FIR length is 8251 samples, longer than a public 2500-sample trial and triggers MNE's distortion warning; a short 2499-tap FIR is not realizable under MNE's high-pass transition constraint. The same zero-phase 4th-order Butterworth IIR is therefore used for training and public trials to preserve independent processing, identical filters and the official frequency band.
preprocessing.reference: Official dataset_maker/make_TUAB.py: raw.filter(0.1, 75), raw.notch_filter(50), raw.resample(200), get_data(units='uV')
preprocessing.training_trial_processing: Each original 50-second trial is filtered and resampled continuously, then split into five non-overlapping 10-second samples
preprocessing.public_trial_processing: Each public 10-second trial is filtered and resampled independently
preprocessing.model_input_scaling: Divide microvolt EEG by 100, matching data_processor/data_preprocess.py and engine_for_finetuning.py
preprocessing.per_sample_or_per_channel_standardizatio: none in the official downstream path

labram_model.name: labram_base_patch200_200
labram_model.checkpoint_loading: Follow run_class_finetuning.py: select checkpoint['model'], retain and strip student.*, discard pretraining-only heads; strict checks for all other backbone keys
labram_model.fc_norm_initialization: Official default LayerNorm weight=1 and bias=0 because fc_norm is absent from pretraining weights; classifier head is unused
labram_model.pooling: fc_norm(mean(all non-CLS channel-time tokens)), the official mean-pooling classification path before head

extraction.smoke_test_before_full_extraction: One HC subject (HC01, 40 samples) and one public user (P_test1, 8 samples)

validation.scheme: Exactly 002: subject-wise 5-fold stratified by health group, folds generated on all 70 subjects before complete HC43 exclusion

normalization.mode: Label-free transductive normalization of extracted embeddings, matching 002
normalization.training_statistics: Per subject and embedding dimension using all 40 samples for that subject, including validation-fold samples
normalization.public_statistics: Per user and embedding dimension using that user's 8 trials

metrics.secondary: Binary F1 for positive emotion, macro F1 and balanced accuracy at threshold 0.5
metrics.diagnostics: Per-fold, per-subject, HC/DEP pooled and subject-macro results, with deltas against the 002 best baseline
